Same scale as the black hazmat rate, split between the three colours. Default 0.3. 0 turns them off. Army bases and labs use the two settings below instead.
Black hazmat zombies wear the normal yellow suit, so you can't tell who carries the cure.
Only with Extensive Health Rework. Chance a hazmat zombie carries one of its Knox treatments: Phalanx pills, test kits, Immunobooster shots, and very rarely Gene Therapy.
Hazmat spawn rates climb from normal on day 1 to the full multiplier on this day, then stay there. Default 60. 0 turns growth off.
What all hazmat spawn rates are multiplied by once the days above have passed. Default 3 (three times as many). 1 turns growth off.
Hazmat zombies see and hear worse through the suit, so you can sneak up on them. Applies to you too while you wear one.
How common black hazmat zombies are in normal areas (not army bases or labs). Not a percent: 0.3 (default) is about 1 in 1,200 zombies, 1 about 1 in 375, 3 about 1 in 125. 0 turns them off.
Percent of zombies in labs that wear a hazmat suit, mostly the white one. Default 8.

Chance for new Zomboxolone and Zomboxycycline loot packs to have doses missing. Applies to hazmat drops and medical container loot. 0 disables it. Existing packs and single-use medicines are unaffected.
Minimum doses in partially used packs
Lowest number of doses left when a pack spawns partially used. Rolls from this number up to 9 doses. Packs hold 10 doses; setting this to 10 keeps them full.
How much a Tactical Satchel holds. Only affects satchels spawned after the change.
Percent of the weight inside the satchel you do not feel. Only affects satchels spawned after the change.

Resetting: each pill sets the infection back to the start. Pausing: each pill stops the infection from getting worse for a while, so you need one every day until you find a cure.

Tells you if you carry the zombie virus.
Cure: Inhaled vapor in a glass tube. Cures a zombie virus infection, but you will feel awful for a while.
Delay: Slows the zombie virus down but does not cure it. Each dose gives you more time before you turn.
Prevention: Take it before you get bitten. Stops the zombie virus from taking hold for a day. Does nothing if you are already infected.
Vaccine: Keeps the zombie virus out for a long time. Does not cure an infection you already have.
The text above your character when you take a med, test yourself or protection wears off.
Moodles for protection, recovery and a positive test (needs MoodleFramework).
You finally feel like yourself again.

The Zomboxolone wore off. The infection is moving again.
The infection is held back for now.
